blocks.text: The documentation explains how the real loop replaces hello, which earlier features now live in metering and hooks, and which environment settings fail closed or fail open.
blocks.title: Runner parity and configuration contract

blocks.text: selected_mode defaults to loop, conn_offers_tools gates tools on an exact capability, and configuration_problems reports missing required secrets or providers without exposing values. SDK logging is kept above DEBUG.
blocks.title: Mode and configuration checks

blocks.text: build_loop creates late-bound emitter functions, real quota and pricing collaborators, a metering factory, a context assembler, and an AgentLoop that offers tools only to capable connections.
blocks.title: Building the process loop

blocks.text: The replay scan walks backward for the most recent text event and distinguishes an unfinished text delta from a closed text_done. _announce_restart emits the notice only when the conversation needs a new answer.
blocks.title: Resume notice detection

blocks.text: _discard edits private hook lists by identity and verifies through public accessors. Pair helpers describe hello and active-loop hooks for cleanup.
blocks.title: Hook lifecycle helpers

blocks.text: install logs configuration problems, removes stale hooks, selects hello or loop mode, sets the process loop, and registers the selected runner and resume/cancel/disconnect hooks.
blocks.title: Idempotent runner installation

purpose: The module joins the loop, context assembler, broker, emitter, metering, and run handlers that are built in separate modules. It preserves a hello kill switch, removes stale hooks safely, adds resume notices for partial replies, and logs only setting names and exception types.
summary: Builds the real code-agent loop and installs it or the hello runner according to process configuration.

Removes selected hook functions and raises if any remain registered.
Returns active-loop hook pairs plus the restart hook.
